description: Multichain's MPC-bridge withdrawal path is gated by an onlyMPC modifier — a single on-chain signing address whose distribution claim (≥3-of-5 independent operators) was unverifiable. In practice, MPC nodes ran on infrastructure under sole physical control of CEO Zhaojun, who was detained in May 2023. Whoever obtained access to the servers signed valid withdrawals from Fantom, BSC, and Ethereum bridge wallets on July 6, 2023. Contract verification logic is correct; the off-chain custodial assumption was false. The canonical exploit_tx here is the 27.65M USDC outflow from the Fantom-bridge contract on Ethereum to suspicious address 0x027F1571… at 18:10 UTC on 2023-07-06.
_live_mode_note: Source code is NOT verified on Etherscan for the Multichain Fantom Bridge contract. Live-mode source-fetch will return zero source files and the runner will short-circuit to 'failed: no source files resolved'. This case is bench-only; bytecode-level R1 (compile-only) handlers are required to validate it end-to-end.
